questions.question: What does the prior probability of a class measure?
options: its share after attributes are seen
its share among the wrong answers
its share in the test set only
its share before attributes are seen
options_en: its share after attributes are seen
its share among the wrong answers
its share in the test set only
its share before attributes are seen
questions.explanation: The prior is the class share known before any attribute value is examined.
questions.explanation_ar: الأولية هي نصيب الصنف المعروف قبل فحص أي قيمة سمة.

questions.question: Why is the class probability called a prior?
options: it is chosen by the analyst freely
it is fixed before the evidence
it is computed after the evidence
it is estimated from the test set
options_en: it is chosen by the analyst freely
it is fixed before the evidence
it is computed after the evidence
it is estimated from the test set
questions.explanation: It is named prior because it is established before the observed attribute evidence.
questions.explanation_ar: سُميت أولية لأنها تُثبت قبل دليل السمات المرصود.

questions.question: What does the likelihood of an attribute value measure?
questions.question_ar: ماذا تقيس إمكانية قيمة سمة معينة؟
options: accuracy of the model on the data
rarity of the value in the data
frequency of the value in the class
frequency of the class in the data
options_en: accuracy of the model on the data
rarity of the value in the data
frequency of the value in the class
frequency of the class in the data
questions.explanation: The likelihood asks how common the value is among records of that class only.
questions.explanation_ar: الإمكانية تسأل عن شيوع القيمة بين سجلات ذلك الصنف فقط.

questions.question: How is the unnormalized score of a class built?
questions.question_ar: كيف تُبنى الدرجة غير المطبَّعة للصنف؟
questions.explanation: The score multiplies the class prior by the likelihoods of the observed values.
questions.explanation_ar: الدرجة تضرب أولية الصنف في إمكانات القيم المرصودة.

questions.question: When comparing two classes, why can the evidence be dropped?
questions.question_ar: عند مقارنة صنفين، لماذا يمكن إسقاط الدليل؟
options: it is larger for the first class
it is identical for both classes
it is unknown for new records
options_en: it is larger for the first class
it is identical for both classes
it is unknown for new records
questions.explanation: The evidence is the same denominator for every candidate class, so it cannot change the winner.
questions.explanation_ar: الدليل مقام واحد لكل صنف مرشح، فلا يغيّر الفائز.

questions.question: What does a very small unnormalized score for a class mean?
questions.question_ar: ماذا تعني درجة غير مطبَّعة صغيرة جداً لصنف؟
questions.explanation: A small score means the prior and likelihoods combine to make that class improbable.
questions.explanation_ar: الدرجة الصغيرة تعني أن الأولية والإمكانات تجعل الصنف غير مرجّح.

questions.question: How are class scores turned into probabilities?
questions.question_ar: كيف تتحول درجات الأصناف إلى احتمالات؟
options: each score over the sum of scores
each score over the largest score
each score times the sum of scores
each score minus the smallest score
options_en: each score over the sum of scores
each score over the largest score
each score times the sum of scores
each score minus the smallest score
questions.explanation: Normalizing divides each class score by the total of all class scores.
questions.explanation_ar: التطبيع يقسم كل درجة على مجموع درجات الأصناف كلها.

questions.question: What can happen if an attribute value never occurs in a class?
questions.question_ar: ماذا قد يحدث إذا لم تظهر قيمة سمة مطلقاً ضمن فئة؟
questions.explanation: If an attribute value never occurs in a class, its estimated likelihood is zero. Multiplying by zero can make the entire score for that class zero.

questions.explanation: |Gaussian Naive Bayes|Continuous numeric attributes|Height, weight, laboratory measurements|

questions.question: Which data type is suitable for Multinomial Naive Bayes?
questions.question_ar: أي نوع بيانات يلائم Multinomial Naive Bayes؟
questions.explanation: |Multinomial Naive Bayes|Count data|Word counts in documents|

questions.question: Which data type is useful for Bernoulli Naive Bayes?
questions.question_ar: أي نوع بيانات يلائم Bernoulli Naive Bayes؟
questions.explanation: |Bernoulli Naive Bayes|Binary attributes|Whether a word occurs or does not occur|

questions.question: Which data setting can Naive Bayes work well with?
questions.question_ar: مع أي إعداد للبيانات قد يعمل Naive Bayes جيداً؟
options: no record can be left unmatched
options_en: no record can be left unmatched
options_ar: لا يمكن أن يبقى أي سجل بلا مطابقة
اعتماد السمات بعضها على بعض بشدة
questions.explanation: Works well for many high-dimensional datasets.

questions.question: What limitation can weaken Naive Bayes performance?
questions.question_ar: أي محدودية قد تضعف أداء Naive Bayes؟
options_ar: اعتماد السمات بعضها على بعض بشدة
questions.explanation: Performance may be weaker when attributes are strongly dependent.
questions.explanation_ar: اعتماد السمات بعضها على بعض بشدة
